# TechnoYuga

> > AI-first software development company specializing in mobile apps, web applications, and custom software solutions for startups and enterprises.

TechnoYuga is a technology consulting and development firm led by Krishna Kumar, offering end-to-end product engineering with expertise in Flutter, Generative AI, iOS/Android development, and industry-specific solutions. Recognized on platforms like Clutch, Upwork, and DesignRush, the company serves clients globally with a focus on MVP development and AI-powered digital transformation.

## Key Topics

- AI App Development
- Mobile App Development (iOS & Android)
- Flutter Cross-Platform Development
- Generative AI Integration
- Custom Software Development
- Web App Development
- MVP Development for Startups
- Natural Language Processing (NLP)
- Blockchain & Smart Contracts
- OTT & Video Streaming Apps
- Machine Learning Solutions
- SaaS Application Development
- Wearable App Development
- eCommerce & Trading Apps
- IT Consulting Services
